=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:146-152 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The custom `_path_glob_matches` function that enforced directory-boundary-aware globstar matching has been replaced with a bare `fnmatch.fnmatchcase(path, entry)` call.
  WHY: Python's `fnmatch` does not treat `/` as a path separator, so `*` can match across directory boundaries and let out-of-scope files bypass the scope guard.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: function `record_lessons_learned` (removed entirely; previously at approximately lines 1638-1685) and its supporting helpers `LESSONS_LEARNED_RECORD_SCHEMA_VERSION`, `validate_lessons_learned_record`, `_lessons_learned_record_path`, `_normalize_lessons_learned_phase`, `_normalize_lessons_learned_kind`, `_normalize_lessons_learned_tags` — all deleted. | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The lessons-learned recording path and its validation/normalization helpers were removed from `ai_memory_lib.py`.
  WHY: Four production scripts still import and call `record_lessons_learned`, so those workflows will now raise `ImportError` and crash at runtime.
- scripts/ai_memory.py: the `cmd_review`, `cmd_prune`, `cmd_search`, `cmd_export` functions and their `add_parser` entries in `build_parser` (removed; previously at approximately lines 900-1000 and 2060-2090) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Four documented CLI subcommands have been deleted: `review`, `prune`, `search`, and `export`.
  WHY: Operator-facing memory maintenance commands now fail with an invalid-choice / unrecognized-subcommand error.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: function `compact_memory`, lines 2316-2329 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `compact_memory` no longer checks `prune_marked_at` when deciding archive eligibility or deletion.
  WHY: Prune-marked records are never archived/removed by the monthly maintenance job and accumulate indefinitely.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: function `retrieve_memory_context`, line 2096 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `_is_prune_marked(record)` filter that excluded prune-marked records from retrieval was removed.
  WHY: Prune-marked records are now returned in prompt context, defeating the prune operation.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: function `promote_candidates`, approximately lines 1725-1770 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `_is_prune_marked(candidate)` guard that skipped prune-marked records during promotion was removed.
  WHY: Records explicitly marked for archival can be promoted back into active/canonical status, undoing the operator's intent.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: lines 217-248 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Schema synchronization changed from a two-phase copy that backfilled missing schemas from `SUPPORT_AI_MEMORY_DIR` to a single-source/fallback pattern.
  WHY: New schema files that exist only in the support directory are no longer copied into consumer workspaces, breaking validation for forward-compatible schema additions.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh: `_AI_LABEL_COLORS` lines 59-64, `_AI_LABEL_DESCS` lines 103-108 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The pipeline labels `ai:retro`, `ai:security-audit`, and `ai:security` were removed from the label registry.
  WHY: Label lookup and reconciliation flows return empty metadata / unknown-label results for those documented workflow labels.
- scripts/render_prompt.py: removed `PHASE_C_PERSONA_PREFIXES` dictionary (previously ~24-89), removed `apply_phase_c_persona_prefix` function (previously ~589-594), removed call from `main()` (previously ~line 776) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The Phase C persona-prefix feature has been removed entirely.
  WHY: Every rendered prompt now ships without its phase-specific persona framing, changing behavior across the pipeline.
- scripts/ai_memory.py and scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: removed imports of `MEMORY_RECORD_SCHEMA_VERSION` (ai_memory.py line 17), `export_memory_records` (ai_memory.py line 28), `list_stale_candidate_records` and `mark_candidate_records_for_prune` (ai_memory.py line 37-38), `search_memory_records` (ai_memory.py line 54). Removed library helpers: `_cosine_similarity`, `_resolve_search_embedding_settings`, `_create_memory_search_embeddings`, `_create_memory_search_embedding`, `_keyword_search_records`, `_embedding_search_records`, `_load_memory_record_entries`, `_normalize_memory_record_schema_name`, `_parse_datetime_utc_or_none`, `_is_prune_marked`, `_record_created_at_key`, `_record_search_text`, `_record_matches_scope` — all removed from ai_memory_lib.py. | sev
